fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled multi-lane truck entrance off SW Regional Airport Blvd at the SW corner; clear lane markings with directional arrows, striped median, and a checkpoint pinch-point (z19/z20 imagery).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Manned guard booth sitting in the lane median between inbound and outbound lanes (dark-roofed ~1-vehicle-footprint structure, 36.3186,-94.2606), plus a check-in canopy building just inside the gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical staffed guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Wide paved apron between the public road and the booth where arriving trucks can stack.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Bobtail/trailer staging lot just inside the gate on the SW (marked stalls, trailers and tractors staged).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approx 2 inbound lanes past the booth; exact split hard to read from overhead - flagged.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Approx 2 outbound lanes with directional arrows; flagged as estimate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide multi-lane gate apron with unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Hundreds of dock doors across multiple faces (upper wing NE face, main building east and south faces); well into 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Massive on-site trailer drop yard - hundreds of trailers parked in long rows east and between the two building wings; 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on physically separate building faces (upper-wing NE docks vs main-building east/south docks).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two connected large building masses (a long NW-SE upper wing and a larger main block) plus a separate SW annex/transportation building; treated as a campus.
fieldNotes.scale: No clearly identifiable truck scale pad confirmed from imagery; flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Gate booth followed by a separate inbound check-in canopy suggests a two-stage entry; flagged as inferred.
fieldNotes.railServed: Line south of the building is a drainage swale, not a rail spur; no rail enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town setting at the SW edge of Bentonville/Centerton with farmland and woods on the south and east; judged Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: Dock/trailer counts are honest overhead estimates; trailersVisible and capacity are order-of-magnitude given the very large multi-row drop yard.
